description: This Dart source file provides analytics-related classes, providers, and functions for a Flutter application, focusing on quiz analytics, filters, and state management.

classes.name: AnalyticsFilter
classes.description: Model representing a filter with start and end date and optional category, used to filter quiz analytics data.

classes.name: QuizKpis
classes.description: Data class holding key performance indicators (KPIs) for quizzes.

classes.name: PerQuizStat
classes.description: Represents statistics for a specific quiz, including attempts, scores, and completion status.

classes.name: QuizAnalytics
classes.description: Aggregated analytics data including KPIs and per-quiz detailed statistics.

classes.name: AnalyticsFilterNotifier
classes.description: State notifier managing the current analytics filter state, with methods to set preset days, custom ranges, and categories.

classes.name: QuizAnalyticsRefresher
classes.description: Notifier providing a mechanism to refresh and trigger recalculation of analytics data.

methods.name: setPresetDays
methods.description: Sets the analytics filter to a preset number of days ending today.

methods.name: setCustomRange
methods.description: Sets the analytics filter to a custom start and end date.

methods.name: setCategory
methods.description: Filters analytics data by specified category.

methods.name: _startOfDay
methods.description: Helper method to get the start of a day in UTC.

methods.name: _endOfDay
methods.description: Helper method to get the end of a day in UTC.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Method to trigger a refresh of the analytics data.
